description: This file defines an abstract base class for websocket services with automatic reconnection, error handling, connection verification, and message processing logic.

classes.name: WebsocketService
classes.description: An abstract base class that manages websocket connections with automatic reconnection, error handling, and message receiving. Subclasses implement specific connection and message handling logic.

methods.name: __init__(self, *, reconnect_on_error: bool = True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the websocket service with optional automatic reconnection on error.

methods.name: bool _verify_connection(self)
methods.description: Verifies that the websocket connection is active and responsive by sending a ping.

methods.name: bool _reconnect_websocket(self, attempt_number: int)
methods.description: Handles reconnection logic for the websocket, including disconnecting and reconnecting.

methods.name: bool _try_reconnect( self, max_retries: int = 3, report_error: Optional[Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]]] = None, )
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect with exponential backoff retry logic, reporting errors as needed.

methods.name: send_with_retry(self, message, report_error: Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]])
methods.description: Sends a message over the websocket, with automatic reconnection and retry on failure.

methods.name: bool _maybe_try_reconnect( self, error: Exception, error_message: str, report_error: Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]], )
methods.description: Decides whether to attempt reconnection based on errors and current state.

methods.name: _receive_task_handler(self, report_error: Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]])
methods.description: Continuously receives messages and handles reconnection logic on errors.

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Prepares for a connection by resetting disconnect flags; calls subclass-specific connection logic.

methods.name: _disconnect(self)
methods.description: Prepares for disconnection by setting disconnect flags; calls subclass-specific disconnection logic.

methods.name: _connect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Abstract method: subclass must implement to establish websocket connection.

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Abstract method: subclass must implement to close websocket connection.

methods.name: _receive_messages(self)
methods.description: Abstract method: subclass must implement to handle receiving and processing websocket messages.

ctags.name: _maybe_try_reconnect
ctags.signature: ( self, error: Exception, error_message: str, report_error: Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]], )

ctags.name: _try_reconnect
ctags.signature: ( self, max_retries: int = 3, report_error: Optional[Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]]] = None, )

ctags.name: send_with_retry
ctags.pattern: /^    async def send_with_retry(self, message, report_error: Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None/
